result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred coverage levels, includes legally required workers’ compensation, and requires certificates on request. Cyber coverage is applicable because IBM processes Customer Data. However, requiring every policy—including CGL and workers’ compensation—to remain in force for one year after the term exceeds the playbook and is unnecessary; any post-termination requirement should be limited to applicable claims-made coverages. The existing risk-of-loss allocation is otherwise preserved, and the drafting is generally professional.
